correctness.rationale: All parameters and boundary cases are explicit: k=alpha+1>=2,d=n+1>=2,m<=k-1. In the B product group, a^k yields pure increment k and (ab)^(k-1) yields increment k-1, whose gcd is one; this proves the full S_k x Z_d action. The proof then derives reachability, pairwise distinguishing words, exact stabilizer of accepted suffix projections, the quotient final set [k-1] and its minimality. Unary source Corollary 32 handles all smaller alpha; zero cases follow from quotient emptiness/nonemptiness. Independently coded finite-state checks cover all 60 triples k=2..6,d=2..5,m=1..k-1; they corroborate rather than prove infinite assertions.

value.rationale: Determining the least alphabet size for the unrestricted quotient accepting-state spectrum is a structural, motivated refinement of a fresh 2026 result. The exact binary threshold (versus bounded unary) resolves a natural missing parameter, and a uniform group construction demonstrates why a third letter is unnecessary at every modulus. It neither merely recomputes a table nor renames the original ternary witness; its key coprime pure-shift identity is new to the examined proof.
